Hualien|Taiwan.f: Hualien is Taiwan's largest county by area, yet 87 percent of it is mountains.

Chiayi|Taiwan.f: In 1787 the Qianlong Emperor renamed the city Chiayi, meaning commended righteousness, to honor residents' loyalty in a rebellion.

Lanyu|Taiwan.f: About 100,000 barrels of nuclear waste are stored on Lanyu, in a facility built in 1982 without consulting residents.
